description: Telehealth: statically trace the full provider path (EHR Session tab -> NativeTelehealthRoom join() -> POST /api/ehr/telehealth start/join -> Chime meeting/attendee -> amazon-chime-sdk-js bind/start -> self-view -> in-room recorder -> captions -> onRecordingReady -> uploadAudioAndStartHealthScribe) and the client path, against .agents/tasks/telehealth-whole-chain/ docs and git history (git log -p on native-telehealth-room.tsx). Find genuine defects (silent failures, state that can stick busy, props not wired, stale-closure on providerConsent/status, notice overwritten by poll, join() calling onConnectionChange(true) before connect so nativeCallActive may stay true after a failed join) and fix only those, minimally, without moving or removing features.
steps: Read app/ehr/native-telehealth-room.tsx fully (join ~L207-272, status poll ~L160-190, recorder ~L290-350, joinDisabled ~L365) and app/api/ehr/telehealth/route.ts (start, join, leave, consent, captions, end) and lib/ehr/telehealth-policy.ts, telehealth-consent.ts, telehealth-origin.ts, telehealth-request.ts.

Verify that every code path out of join() (success, thrown error, !live.current) leaves busy=false, onConnectionChange state consistent, and a visible message. Verify the status poll cannot overwrite a join failure or 'Connecting…' notice. Verify the Join button's disabled inputs (providerConsent = sessionForm.consentObtained at full-production-interface.tsx ~L3865) are what the user sees checked, and that a disabled button always shows joinDisabledReason.

Verify isAllowedTelehealthOrigin accepts ehr.revealing-leads-to-healing-wellness-services.org and www, and the confirmationVersion/consent body the client sends matches what route.ts validates; check for server errors that would surface only as generic messages.
Confirm the top-of-page mic scribe (Start recording - microphone, ~L3875) is independent of the room state and that audio from the room recorder reaches uploadAudioAndStartHealthScribe the same way.
Fix only real defects found (with file/line evidence). If a path is sound, say so. Add node:test coverage for any fix.

Write report to .agents/tasks/telehealth-intake-cloud/report.md in plain language covering BOTH telehealth and intake email: what each path does, root causes with file/line evidence, what changed and why, what was verified here, and exactly what remains unverifiable without AWS or the user's browser. Commit all work on the current branch fix/telehealth-and-intake-email with clear messages (no push).
acceptance_criteria: Report exists and is honest about unverifiable items
No existing feature removed or moved
verification: node --test on the new/related tests in tests/
git log shows commits on fix/telehealth-and-intake-email
findings: Fixed in native-telehealth-room.tsx: (1) audioVideoDidStop did not lock its notice so the 5s poll overwrote it with The room is open (matches reported symptom); now locks and shows reason/status code in the alert. (2) stale status poll could disconnect a fresh call; now ignores responses requested before joinedAt. (3) in-room recorder stop used stale consent/upload closure and uploaded after consent withdrawal; now discards via refs. Join/busy/onConnectionChange paths, button reasons, origin, consent body, mic scribe independence verified sound. Tests: tests/telehealth-room-join-safety.test.ts (+4 related) pass offline. Report at .agents/tasks/telehealth-intake-cloud/report.md, copied to docs/telehealth-intake-cloud-report.md. No tsc/build possible offline.
